authorization.scope: Analyze SPEC-0001, SPEC-0002 and SPEC-0003 as specimens only

classification.scope: Public-facing outputs derived from private authoring context
classification.authorization_condition: No separate permission to release private source context

comparisons.assessment: Same core prohibition; SPEC-0003 explicitly distinguishes permission to publish the result from permission to publish input context.
Private context can contain confidential information, but origin/context protection also applies when no factual secret is present.
Already prohibited within public Git repositories; this proposal also covers other public communications and generated artifacts.
The catalog diary permission applies to private diaries, not public release; public output produced from a private diary is separately governed.

disposition.outcome: No second competing candidate is created for this duplicate; original source specimen retained for provenance.

uncertainties: Machine-comparison relies on literal normalized predicates; related content classes and action synonyms require semantic review.
